cases.name: test6_crescent_on_rim_union_angle0
cases.note: A cylinder r 10 h 10 united with the crescent prism (r 6 cylinder centred on its rim at 0 degrees minus the r 10 cylinder), as wr528_crescent_on_rim_union_angle0. At the default fixes the port's check reports SmEdgeuse test #6 (UV trim curve owner != edge use) twice here (#1615 diagnostic). Compares the failed tests of SMLib's capi check (ValidatePointers, then AssertValid, level 2) of the result with the port's.

cases.name: test6_crescent_alone
cases.note: The crescent prism alone: the r 6 cylinder centred on (10, 0) minus the r 10 cylinder (the inner Boolean of the union cases), so a test #6 failure there can be told from one the union adds. Narrows down where the port's SmEdgeuse test #6 failures come from. Compares the failed tests of SMLib's capi check (ValidatePointers, then AssertValid, level 2) of the result with the port's.

cases.name: test6_drilled_box
cases.note: A 40 x 40 x 20 box minus a drill (r 3, a 118 degree tip, 10 deep from the top at (20, 20)), the drill the r 3 cylinder from the tip's base to z 21 united with the cone of the tip (apex down; the #1609 diagnostic revolves the drill's profile instead, which this runner cannot build). The port's check of the box minus the revolved drill reports SmEdgeuse test #6 once (#1609 diagnostic). Compares the failed tests of SMLib's capi check (ValidatePointers, then AssertValid, level 2) of the result with the port's.

cases.name: test6_drill_alone
cases.note: The drill of test6_drilled_box alone: the r 3 cylinder united with the cone of its tip. Narrows down where the port's SmEdgeuse test #6 failures come from. Compares the failed tests of SMLib's capi check (ValidatePointers, then AssertValid, level 2) of the result with the port's.

cases.name: test6_flat_hole
cases.note: The box of test6_drilled_box minus the r 3 cylinder alone (a flat-bottomed hole), to tell a cone-related failure from a hole-related one. Narrows down where the port's SmEdgeuse test #6 failures come from. Compares the failed tests of SMLib's capi check (ValidatePointers, then AssertValid, level 2) of the result with the port's.
